t: 阿纳斯塔修斯皇帝去世后的第二天，查士丁一世被君士坦丁堡牧首加冕为拜占庭皇帝。
te: Justin I is crowned Byzantine Emperor by the patriarch of Constantinople the day after the death of emperor Anastasius.
